article_title: Breast cancer checks missing lots of at risk younger women, says study

tasks.prompt: What is the study’s central finding?
options: Younger women no longer need breast-cancer risk checks
Current NICE referral criteria miss many under-50 women who are at increased risk
Family history predicts every breast-cancer case
The NHS has already replaced all existing criteria
tasks.correct_answer: Current NICE referral criteria miss many under-50 women who are at increased risk
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המחקר מצא שהקריטריונים הקיימים להפניה מפספסים נשים רבות מתחת לגיל 50 שנמצאות בסיכון מוגבר.

tasks.prompt: How many women under 50 were included in the researchers’ analysis?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החוקרים מאוניברסיטת קיימברידג׳ ניתחו נתונים של 1,258 נשים מתחת לגיל 50.

tasks.prompt: What did the Boadicea model achieve compared with the current approach?
options: It removed the need for specialist assessment
It referred fewer women than NICE criteria
It identified about eight times as many women who developed breast cancer
It predicted cancer with complete certainty
tasks.correct_answer: It identified about eight times as many women who developed breast cancer
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המודל Boadicea זיהה בערך פי שמונה יותר נשים שפיתחו את המחלה.

tasks.prompt: What proportion of under-50 women might be classed above population-level risk using Boadicea?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הניתוח העריך שכמעט 27% יסווגו כבעלות סיכון מעל רמת האוכלוסייה.

tasks.prompt: In the report, what does “referred” mean?
options: Sent to another service for further assessment
tasks.correct_answer: Sent to another service for further assessment
tasks.explanation_hebrew: referred פירושו הופנתה להמשך הערכה או טיפול אצל שירות מתאים.

tasks.prompt: What does “multifactorial” mean when describing a risk model?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: multifactorial מתאר מודל שמשלב כמה גורמי סיכון, ולא מסתמך רק על גורם אחד.

tasks.prompt: Explain the difference between “criterion”, “assessment” and “risk” as used in the article. Answer in 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להגדיר אמת מידה, הערכה מקצועית והסתברות למחלה, ולהראות את הקשר ביניהם.
expected_points: A criterion is a rule used to decide who qualifies for referral
Assessment is a more detailed evaluation by professionals
Risk is the estimated likelihood of developing disease
Criteria determine who receives further assessment of risk

tasks.prompt: Why might identifying high-risk women earlier improve outcomes? Answer in 3–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין זיהוי מוקדם, מעקב או מניעה, אבחון מוקדם וסיכויי הצלחה גבוהים יותר של טיפול.
expected_points: Earlier identification can lead to targeted monitoring or preventive support
Cancer may be detected before it spreads
Treatment is more likely to succeed when disease is found earlier
The approach may allow more personalised care

tasks.prompt: Write an 90–130 word summary covering the weakness of current NICE criteria, the Cambridge study, Boadicea and the debate about changing practice.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול הסתמכות על היסטוריה משפחתית, 1,258 נשים, שיעור ההחמצה, יתרון Boadicea והצורך במשאבים/מחקר נוסף.
expected_points: Current referral criteria rely heavily on family history and miss many higher-risk women
Boadicea identified substantially more women at increased risk
Earlier identification could support prevention or earlier treatment
NICE said more evidence on feasibility and outcomes is needed before changing guidance

tasks.prompt: Evaluate one benefit and two practical concerns about replacing the current criteria with a broader risk model. Write 5–7 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג תועלת בזיהוי מוקדם ושני חששות כגון כוח אדם, ציוד, חרדה, שוויון או הפניות מיותרות.
expected_points: Benefit: more high-risk women could receive earlier support
Concern: extra referrals require staff, equipment and funding
Concern: additional testing may cause anxiety or unequal access
Conclude that implementation should be evaluated carefully
